subject: New semantic gate: native sampler must follow sampler_desc per-use resolution, not raw Metal fields
body:
New cross-owner semantic mismatch found while reviewing actual producer. The native wire currently copies ORIGINAL Metal sampler fields from ComputeResource (runtime_pipeline.inc379..392); air_bridge.rs combined/separate sampler match uses compare/integer but ignores opaque_black and never calls bind::sampler_desc (only local compute_sampler_desc builds the input facts). Shared helper then directly packs those fields. That is not necessarily the sampler required by the selected translated program.

Pinned translator contract: bind/plan/resources.rs95..135 explicitly says use sampler_desc(device, descriptor, compare, integer, opaque_black, image_format), including format-filter checks and opaque-black mapping. metal/sampler.rs292..454 resolves per-use semantics: integer views force min/mag/mipmap NEAREST and no anisotropy; nearest min/mag on a non-Metal native device disables hardware anisotropy because translated shader handles taps; anisotropy rounds/clamps to device bound; nearest/linear LOD clamps snap to Metal grid; NotMipmapped clamps are rewritten; reduction is WEIGHTED_AVERAGE. Its border_used457..475 maps ClampToZero AND ClampToBorderColor through the selected borderColor.

Concrete currently accepted mismatch: sampler_flags bit1 records integer use but bridge only consumes bit0(compare); shared helper n2t_sampler_pack_for_format has no integer min/mag restriction, so original LINEAR integer sampler remains LINEAR in Mali words instead of required NEAREST. Also shared helper773..776 unconditionally chooses zero border for ClampToZero, discarding an explicitly opaque-white border, while pinned sampler_desc contract preserves selected borderColor. These are source-proven contract mismatches; not new hardware-result claims.

Proposed owner split: compute exports/resolves ACTUAL per-descriptor VkSamplerDesc (or equivalent explicit native sampler facts) from bind::sampler_desc and serializes those, carrying opaque_black/border_components or explicitly refusing unrepresentable cases. Texture helper should remain a native descriptor encoder; do not globally change legacy Metal helper behavior without separating old qualified path. Test real Rust plan -> actual wire -> all32 sampler bytes for integer+linear/aniso, float nearest+aniso, nonintegral LOD clamp, ClampToZero+opaqueWhite, and opaque_black Transparent/Mapped cases. This is beyond merely changing allocationformat toviewformat. Never silently substitute raw caller state for selected-plan sampler semantics. No production edit/build by audit.
